newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan stocks advance, Nikkei up more than 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan stocks advance, Nikkei up more than 2 pct.

text.p: Japanese stocks rose sharply on Wednesday, as the weaker yen sparked buying of export-oriented multinational issues, especially in the high-technology and automobile sectors.
The key market index gained more than two percent in afternoon trade.

The Nikkei 225 average surged by more than two percent but pared its gains slightly in late afternoon trade. At 0537 GMT, it had gained 352.86 points or 1.98 percent to stand at 18,149.43. Its March futures rose 370 points to 18,160.
"After the Nikkei 225 rose above 18,000, buying gathered momentum," said Sueharu Ando, head of the equity trading division at Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
Although there were some fears that the weaker yen could spark sell-offs of yen-denominated assets by foreign investors, no significant sales had been detected so far, brokers said.
